mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe WHERE user_id = #{id}) AS my_recipe_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like WHERE user_id = #{id}) AS like_recipe_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_board WHERE users_id = #{id}) AS my_review_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_board_reply WHERE users_id = #{id}) AS my_reply_cnt FROM DUAL

SELECT
rb.id, rb.subject, rb.content, rb.image_url, rb.hit, rb.created_at, rb.rcp_seq,
r.rcp_nm, r.att_file_no_main,
u.id AS chef_id, u.nickname AS chef_nickname, u.profile_image_url AS chef_profile_image
FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN recipe r ON rb.rcp_seq = r.rcp_seq LEFT OUTER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE rb.users_id = #{id} ORDER BY rb.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT
rbr.id, rbr.review_board_id, rbr.content, rbr.created_at,
rb.subject AS rev_subject
FROM review_board_reply rbr JOIN review_board rb ON rbr.review_board_id = rb.id WHERE rbr.users_id = #{id} ORDER BY rbr.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
